moments.title: Clocks Went Back: Extra Hour of Sleep!
moments.blurb: British Summer Time officially ended yesterday, Sunday October 25th, as clocks went back an hour to Greenwich Mean Time.

angles.name: Morning light
angles.copy: Did you enjoy that extra hour in bed yesterday? The clocks went back across the UK, marking the end of British Summer Time. Time to embrace those lighter mornings!

angles.name: Autumn vibes
angles.copy: Officially back on Greenwich Mean Time! Yesterday saw the UK 'fall back' an hour. How are you adjusting to the darker evenings and brighter starts?

angles.name: Musical influence
angles.copy: Turning 75 today, Bootsy Collins! From James Brown to Parliament-Funkadelic, his bass lines shaped funk music forever. Sending cosmic birthday wishes!
